picks.readme:
# Agent Autoloop

**让你的命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进到底；平时不烦你，遇到拿不准的事才发卡片找你拍板。**

**中文** | [English](README.en.md)

[上手](#上手) · [场景模板](#拿来即用的场景模板) · [插件](#插件体系四个方向都能自由替换) · [内核](#内核的四个机制) · [文档](#更多文档)

![架构图](docs/architecture.svg)

## 它解决什么问题？

平时我们用 Claude Code、Codex 这类命令行 Agent，大多是“人守着终端用”：你输一句话，盯着它跑，等它问你下一步；一旦关掉窗口或者人走开，事情就断了。

**Agent Autoloop** 是一个极轻量的自动化中台。它把任务调度做成一个零外部依赖的**内核**，把事件来源、Agent、通知通道，甚至代码上线流水线全部拆成可随时插拔的**插件**。

- **一台电脑、一条命令就能跑。** 装在你的 Windows、Mac 或 Linux 上，不用买云服务器，也不用开放公网端口。
- **一行配置接新 Agent。** 不需要 SDK，也不需要改 Agent 源码，能接收提示词并打印最后一条回复的命令行工具都能接。
- **没有后台界面。** 需要你拍板时把卡片推到飞书、钉钉、企微、Slack、Discord 或桌面通知；想看全局进展，敲一行命令。

## 上手

支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。需要 Node 24 或更新、Git，以及一个已经登录的命令行 Agent；macOS/Linux 还需要 curl，不需要 GitHub 账号。也可以把[安装说明](INSTALL.md)交给你的 Agent。

Windows PowerShell：

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

macOS / Linux：

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/main/install.sh | sh
```

安装和 `agent-autoloop update` 都装最新的 [Release](https://github.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/releases)，那是通过了全部检查的版本。

装好后用你本机的 Agent 真实走一遍“提问 → 退出等回复 → 拍板 → 接着干完”：

```bash
agent-autoloop try
```

下面是在终端里的真实输出：

```text
事件发出去了，Agent 开始干活……

Agent 结束了这一轮，问了你一个问题。它现在不占进程、不花 Token。

【等你决定】#1 试跑：选一个颜色
这是一次试跑，选哪个都行。
  1. 蓝色
  2. 绿色
回答：agent-autoloop answer 1 <序号>
答完运行 agent-autoloop status，能看到它接着把活干完。
```

交互终端里直接输入数字回车；非交互终端运行 `agent-autoloop answer 1 2` 选择“绿色”。再跑 `agent-autoloop status`，就能看到它接上刚才的会话并显示“你选了绿色，试跑通过”，还有今天和最近 7 天的轮数、Token 和费用（[统计口径](skills/agent-autoloop/SKILL.md#看情况回答)）。

## 一件事怎么转起来

编号和上面的架构图一一对应：

1. **新事件进来。** 早上 9 点的定时任务、GitHub 上新提的 Issue、业务系统报的错，都变成一条标准事件送进内核。
2. **按规则派活。** 内核照你写的规则，决定交给哪个 Agent、去哪个目录干。同一件事排队时又来的消息，会合并成一轮处理。
3. **干完一轮就退出。** Agent 把结果写在最后一条回复里，进程直接退出。
4. **拿不准才问你。** 碰到删数据、停服、花钱、对外发消息这类事，内核通过飞书或桌面通知发一张卡片给你。等你回复期间，它不占后台进程，也不消耗 Token。
5. **点一下，接着干。** 你选完，它接上原来的对话，把剩下的活干完。

能自己搞定的事走图上方的自动闭环：直接办完，或者约个时间（比如半小时后）再醒来复查，全程不打扰你。

## 日常怎么配？

### 写一份规则（`rules.json`）

不需要写胶水代码。打开 `~/.agent-autoloop/rules.json`，在 `rules` 里写清楚**什么事、交给谁、在哪个目录干**。`to` 填 `agents` 里已有的名字。比如每天早上 9 点写早报：

```json
{
  "name": "早报",
  "when": { "cron": "0 9 * * *" },
  "to": "codex",
  "cwd": "~/notes",
  "prompt": "整理昨天的笔记和提交，写今天的早报。"
}
```

外部事件写法一样，只是要先接好来源。比如有人提新 Issue 时交给 Codex，先按[说明](skills/agent-autoloop/SKILL.md#接一个事件插件)在 `sources` 里登记 `github`：

```json
{
  "name": "处理 issue",
  "when": { "source": "github", "types": ["issues.opened"] },
  "to": "codex",
  "cwd": "~/code/app",
  "skill": "handle-issue",
  "parallel": 3
}
```

`agent-autoloop pause <规则>`、`resume <规则>` 暂停和恢复一条规则，暂停期间到点不跑、来事件不接也不排队，恢复后不自动补跑；恢复时会列出暂停期间跳过的事件，照着给出的 `agent-autoloop replay <规则> --since <时间>` 一次补跑，每条只补一次。`agent-autoloop run <规则>` 立即跑一轮。这些记在中台的日志里，不改 `rules.json`。`agent-autoloop runs [规则]` 列出做完的轮次，`--before <第几轮>` 往前翻，拿到编号再用 `agent-autoloop why <第几轮>` 看来龙去脉。

保存后几秒内自动生效，可以运行 `agent-autoloop check` 检查，`agent-autoloop check <文件>` 检查一份草稿，不碰正在跑的中台；`agent-autoloop rules explain [文件]` 看生效的规则和下次定时（也可以指定一份草稿），`agent-autoloop emit <类型> --dry-run` 预演一条事件会派给谁（不连接中台、不写日志）。就算改错了，或者文件被删、读不到，系统也会继续按旧规则跑，并发卡片提醒你。

### Agent 怎么跟中台配合？

中台对 Agent 只有一个约定：**在最后一条回复里交代结果**。事情办完了，正常输出一句结论就行。需要向你请示时，在回复末尾附一段 `agent-autoloop` 代码块：

````text
订单已经核对完毕，库存充足。

```agent-autoloop
{
  "ask": [{
    "title": "怎么发货？",
    "text": "两种方式今天都能发出。",
    "options": ["快递", "自提"],
    "key": "shipping"
  }]
}
```
````

除了提问（`ask`），还能发通知（`notice`）、关闭已解决的卡片（`resolve`）、预约复查（`later`）和触发新事件（`events`）。通告不需要回答，但结案时可以顺手写一句处理说明，这句话会留在卡片上；只是告诉一声的通告标成 `fyi`，不带按钮。万一 JSON 写错了，中台只让它在原会话里重写最后这段回复，不会把已经干完的业务重做一遍；重写也失败时，保留原结论并通知你回执没有生效（通用命令没有会话，直接走这一步）。接着旧会话跑也一样：会话接不上才开新的；接上了、干到一半断了，就算没跑成，过几分钟回到原会话重试，不开新会话重做。同一事项的新事件默认开新会话；规则写 `"resume": true` 就接着上一轮的会话。Claude Code 的订阅用量到了上限，中台按它报的恢复时间停止给它派活，排着的和新来的事件都留着，到点自动接着派，并通知你一次几点恢复。

picks.name: minimind
picks.desc: 🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
picks.readme:
![logo](./images/logo.png)
![visitors](https://visitor-badge.laobi.icu/badge?page_id=jingyaogong/minimind) [![GitHub Repo stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/jingyaogong/minimind?style=social)](https://github.com/jingyaogong/minimind/stargazers) [![GitHub Code License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/jingyaogong/minimind)](LICENSE) [![GitHub last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/jingyaogong/minimind)](https://github.com/jingyaogong/minimind/commits/master) [![GitHub pull request](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-blue)](https://github.com/jingyaogong/minimind/pulls) [![Collection](https://img.shields.io/badge/🤗-MiniMind%20%20Collection-blue)](https://huggingface.co/collections/jingyaogong/minimind-66caf8d999f5c7fa64f399e5)
![GitHub Trend](https://trendshift.io/api/badge/repositories/12586)

"大道至简"

中文 | [English](./README_en.md)
* 此开源项目旨在完全从 0 开始，仅用 3 块钱成本与 2 小时训练时间，即可训练出规模约为 64M 的超小语言模型 MiniMind。 * MiniMind 系列极其轻量，主线最小版本体积约为 GPT-3 的 $\frac{1}{2700}$，力求让普通个人 GPU 也能快速完成训练与复现。 * 项目同时开源了大模型的极简结构与完整训练链路，覆盖 MoE、数据清洗、预训练（Pretrain）、监督微调（SFT）、LoRA、RLHF（DPO）、RLAIF（PPO / GRPO / CISPO）、Tool Use、Agentic RL、自适应思考与模型蒸馏等全过程代码。 * MiniMind 同时拓展了视觉模态模型 [MiniMind-V](https://github.com/jingyaogong/minimind-v)、多模态 Omni 模型 [MiniMind-O](https://github.com/jingyaogong/minimind-o)、扩散语言模型（MiniMind-dLM）、线性模型（MiniMind-Linear），详见 [Discussion](https://github.com/jingyaogong/minimind/discussions)。 * 项目所有核心算法代码均从 0 使用 PyTorch 原生实现，不依赖第三方库提供的高层抽象接口。 * 这不仅是一个大语言模型全阶段开源复现项目，也是一套面向 LLM 入门与实践的教程。 * 希望此项目能为更多人提供一个可复现、可理解、可扩展的起点，一起感受创造的乐趣，并推动更广泛 AI 社区的进步。 > 注：本项目基于 Apache 2.0 协议开源，完全免费。“2 小时” 指 SFT 阶段在单张 NVIDIA 3090 上跑完 `1 epoch` 的实测耗时，“3 块钱” 指对应时段的 GPU 租用成本。 ---
![minimind-3](./images/minimind-3.gif) [🔗 在线体验](https://www.modelscope.cn/studios/gongjy/MiniMind) | [🔗 视频介绍](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV12dHPeqE72)
--- ## ❤️ 赞助
MiniMind × Infistar.cc：Claude、GPT、Gemini、DeepSeek等200+模型一个Key搞定，低至官方0.1折（省99%），100%官方纯血可验真，千条线路自动切换。通过专属链接注册即送¥5。
关于赞助与合作
MiniMind 以 Apache 2.0 协议完全开源、永久免费。赞助完全自愿，不换取任何特权，也不影响项目使用。感谢每一位支持者，让这个业余时间维护的项目得以持续。 赞助方式包括按月占位，或直接赞助 GPU 服务器（算力可能用于项目相关或不相关的研究性探索）。 如有意向，欢迎通过 [邮件](mailto:gongjy.cs@foxmail.com) 联系。
--- # 📌 项目介绍 大语言模型（Large Language Model, LLM）的出现，引发了全球范围内对 AI 的空前关注。无论是 ChatGPT、DeepSeek 还是 Qwen，都以惊艳的效果让人真切感受到这场技术浪潮的冲击力。然而，动辄数百亿参数的模型规模，使得它们对个人设备而言不仅难以训练，甚至连部署都显得遥不可及。打开大模型的“黑盒子”，真正去理解其内部运作机制，本应是一件令人心潮澎湃的事。遗憾的是，绝大多数探索最终都止步于使用 LoRA 等技术对现有大模型做少量微调，学习一些新指令或特定任务。这更像是在教牛顿如何使用 21 世纪的智能手机——虽然有趣，却偏离了理解物理本质的初衷。 与此同时，第三方的大模型框架与工具库，如 `transformers` / `trl` / `peft` 等，往往只暴露出高度抽象的接口。只需短短十几行代码，就可以完成“加载模型 + 加载数据集 + 推理 + 强化学习”的全流程训练。这种高效封装固然便利，却也在一定程度上把开发者与底层实现隔离开来，削弱了深入理解 LLM 核心代码的机会

picks.name: HGhub
picks.readme:
HGhub

一个通过插件连接内容的通用视频播放器。

开始使用 · 在线文档 · 插件开发 · 参与开发 · 反馈问题

HGhub 将浏览、搜索、播放和个人片库放在同一个应用中。通过导入 JavaScript 插件，你可以接入不同内容来源，并使用统一的界面观看与管理内容。 **应用不内置内容源，不分发第三方插件，也不提供官方源列表。** 首次使用需自行导入插件，无需注册 HGhub 账号；来源要求登录时，由对应插件提供登录入口。 ## 核心体验 - **沉浸式播放**：桌面与移动端界面，配合手势和播放控制，在面板中查看详情、选集与评论。 - **多来源浏览与搜索**：推荐、分类筛选和聚合搜索，支持按来源查看结果，并保留本地搜索历史。 - **灵活的播放选择**：支持 HLS 与普通视频，切换线路、清晰度和解析器，也可搜索其他来源继续观看。 - **自己的片库**：管理本地收藏、观看历史与续播进度；支持追更，以及将插件提供的云端列表导入本地收藏。 - **按需扩展**：通过文件、网址或插件列表导入内容源与解析器，检查更新，并在更新失败时恢复上一可用版本。 - **更多内容形式**：除点播外，还可通过插件接入直播、信息流和图文内容。 具体内容、账号、评论与互动能力取决于所安装的插件。 ## 开始使用 插件版处于早期开发阶段，目前可[从源码运行或构建](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)。当前重点完善 Windows 与 Android，其他平台仍在适配和验证；详见[支持状态](docs/developers/status.md)。 1. 打开 **插件中心 → 导入与订阅**。移动端从“我的”进入插件中心。 2. 选择插件文件、粘贴代码，或输入插件／列表网址；确认安装并启用。 3. 从首页、搜索或分类找到内容，开始播放。需要切换首页来源时，可在设置中选择。 HGhub 维护播放器与插件接口，第三方内容的可用性由相应来源决定。 ## 文档 **[打开在线文档站 →](https://minireel.github.io/HGhub/)** | 我想…… | 从这里开始 | | --- | --- | | 制作一个内容源或解析器插件 | [插件开发教程](docs/developers/index.md) | | 了解插件文件、宿主 API 与内容模型 | [HPP 插件协议](docs/plugin-protocol/README.md) | | 让 Agent 协助开发插件 | [Agent 开发指南](docs/developers/agent.md) | | 修改客户端或自行构建 | [客户端开发指南](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) | | 查看已支持与待完善的能力 | [支持状态](docs/developers/status.md) | 客户端使用 **Rust · Tauri 2 · React · TypeScript** 构建。HPP 插件协议仍在演进，编写插件前请阅读当前支持状态。 ## 参与、交流、贡献 欢迎通过 [Issues](https://github.com/Minireel/HGhub/issues) 反馈问题、提出想法，或提交 [Pull Request](https://github.com/Minireel/HGhub/pulls) 参与改进。报告问题时，请附上应用版本、操作系统和复现步骤。 项目本身由我独立维护，维护者会根据时间与精力处理反馈，不承诺第三方插件或站点持续可用。维护范围与权益反馈方式见[项目声明](docs/PROJECT_POLICY.md)。 HGhub 欢迎您的贡献，任何一个协议都需要大量、长久的踩坑、试错、经验总结，使它变的越来越完善。您的任何 Issues 与 PR 都对 HGhub 帮助良多！ 社区交流：[Linux.DO](https://linux.do/)。 ## 许可证与非商业立场 本项目源码公开，采用 [PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0](LICENSE)。**禁止商业用途**，包括销售、广告变现、卡密、VIP、付费解锁，以及作为收费产品或服务的一部分使用；具体以许可证全文为准。 维护者**不提供商业授权，不接受广告、推广或商务合作**，也未授权任何人以本项目名义收费。社区技术贡献与问题反馈不属于商务合作。 项目不运营内容托管服务，与外部内容提供者无官方隶属或背书关系。完整责任边界、维护政策与权益反馈说明见[项目声明](docs/PROJECT_POLICY.md)。

picks.name: chrome-devtools-mcp
picks.readme:
# Chrome DevTools for agents

[![npm chrome-devtools-mcp package](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/chrome-devtools-mcp.svg)](https://npmjs.org/package/chrome-devtools-mcp)

Chrome DevTools for agents (`chrome-devtools-mcp`) lets your coding agent (such as Antigravity, Claude, Cursor or Copilot)
control and inspect a live Chrome browser. It is available as a
Model-Context-Protocol (MCP) server and as a [CLI][cli]. Both give your AI
coding assistant access to the full power of Chrome DevTools for reliable
automation, in-depth debugging, and performance analysis.

[Tool reference][tool-reference] | [CLI][cli] | [Skills][skills] | [Changelog][changelog] | [Contributing][contributing] | [Troubleshooting][troubleshooting] | [Design Principles][design-principles]

## Key features

- **Get performance insights**: Uses [Chrome
  DevTools](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/devtools-frontend) to record
  traces and extract actionable performance insights.
- **Advanced browser debugging**: Analyze network requests, take screenshots and
  check browser console messages (with source-mapped stack traces).
- **Reliable automation**. Uses
  [puppeteer](https://github.com/puppeteer/puppeteer) to automate actions in
  Chrome and automatically wait for action results.

## Disclaimers

`chrome-devtools-mcp` exposes content of the browser instance to the MCP clients
allowing them to inspect, debug, and modify any data in the browser or DevTools.
Avoid sharing sensitive or personal information that you don't want to share with
MCP clients.

`chrome-devtools-mcp` officially supports Google Chrome and [Chrome for Testing](https://developer.chrome.com/blog/chrome-for-testing/) only.
Other Chromium-based browsers may work, but this is not guaranteed, and you may encounter unexpected behavior. Use at your own discretion.
We are committed to providing fixes and support for the latest version of [Extended Stable Chrome](https://chromiumdash.appspot.com/schedule).

Performance tools may send trace URLs to the Google CrUX API to fetch real-user
experience data. This helps provide a holistic performance picture by
presenting field data alongside lab data. This data is collected by the [Chrome
User Experience Report (CrUX)](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/crux). To disable
this, run with the `--no-performance-crux` flag.

## **Usage statistics**

Google collects usage statistics (such as tool invocation success rates, latency, and environment information) to improve the reliability and performance of Chrome DevTools MCP.

Data collection is **enabled by default**. You can opt-out by passing the `--no-usage-statistics` flag when starting the server:

```json
"args": ["-y", "chrome-devtools-mcp@latest", "--no-usage-statistics"]
```

Google handles this data in accordance with the [Google Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy).

Google's collection of usage statistics for Chrome DevTools MCP is independent from the Chrome browser's usage statistics. Opting out of Chrome metrics does not automatically opt you out of this tool, and vice-versa.

Collection is disabled if `CHROME_DEVTOOLS_MCP_NO_USAGE_STATISTICS` or `CI` env variables are set.

## Update checks

By default, the server periodically checks the npm registry for updates and logs a notification when a newer version is available.
You can disable these update checks by setting the `CHROME_DEVTOOLS_MCP_NO_UPDATE_CHECKS` environment variable.

## Requirements

- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) [LTS](https://github.com/nodejs/Release#release-schedule) version.
- [Chrome](https://www.google.com/chrome/) current stable version or newer.
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/)

## Getting started

Add the following config to your MCP client:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "chrome-devtools": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "chrome-devtools-mcp@latest"]
    }
  }
}
```

> [!NOTE]
> Using `chrome-devtools-mcp@latest` ensures that your MCP client will always use the latest version of the Chrome De

picks.name: xcl
picks.desc: Xbox Series compatibility layer for Windows - runs console game code natively, reimplements the console system libraries and recompiles RDNA2 shaders to DXIL
picks.readme:
Games · Highlights · How it works · Quick start · What works · Controls · Building and usage · Tests · Contributing

# XCL – Xbox Series X|S → Windows compatibility layer XCL is a compatibility layer that runs Xbox Series X|S (GDK) games you own on a Windows PC - in the spirit of Wine/Proton. There is no CPU emulation: the game's x64 code runs natively, and XCL provides its own, independently written implementations of the console system libraries the PC does not have (`kernelx.dll`, XGameRuntime, `d3d12_xs.dll`, …). The console's GPU code (RDNA2 machine code) is recompiled into PC shaders (HLSL → DXIL). > [!IMPORTANT] > XCL works only on unpacked game files you already own. It does not download, decrypt or unpack game packages (XVC / MSIXVC) and contains nothing for circumventing DRM. The repository holds no code, headers or binaries from the console SDK, no keys and no game data; the Windows components XCL relies on (XGameRuntime, XAudio2, D3D12, DXC) come from your own system or the public Windows SDK and are not distributed with XCL.

## Games

| Game | State | What works | Limits | |---|---|---|---| | **Minecraft Preview**
`Microsoft.MinecraftBeta` 1.18.3064.0 | ✅ playable | fully playable | – | | **Unicorn Overlord**
`SEGAofAmericaInc.Pa253b0c1Y` 1.0.0.6 | ✅ playable | fully playable | – | | **Fortnite**
`436609B6.FortniteClient` 2.0.1461.7919 | ✅ works | works fully, as far as the game allows without its online services | the game itself is online-only (multiplayer servers) | | **XDefiant**
`Ubisoft.XDefiant-Game` 1.0.0.186 | ✅ works | works fully, as far as the game allows without its servers | the game's own servers have been shut down | | **A newer retail game** | 🚧 **≈ 60 %**
estimate | starts in ~4 s, runs at a steady 30 fps without a crash, shows its menus and goes on past the first one to its settings; fits a 32 GB machine (~15 GB committed in the menus). With the NVIDIA integration branch ([#2057](https://github.com/xcl-dev/xcl/pull/2057)) it goes on into its 3D world: **~5 fps there** on an RTX 5090 (14 fps on average over a whole 5-minute run, its menus and loading included) |

picks.name: Lichii
picks.readme:
⚠️ Lichii has no official website ⚠️

> [!CAUTION] > **Lichii has no official website.** The only site run by this project is the **game compatibility website, [lichii.zortos.me](https://lichii.zortos.me)**, for compatibility reports only. Download Lichii **only** from this repository's [releases page](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases). Any other "Lichii" website or download (such as lichii.org) is not ours and may contain malware ([#545](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/issues/545)).

# Lichii [![Total downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/zortos293/Lichii/total)](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases) [![Latest release downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/zortos293/Lichii/latest/total)](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases) [![Latest release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/zortos293/Lichii)](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases) Lichii is an experimental, open-source Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 emulator written in C++. It builds on Eglantine, Eden, yuzu and Sudachi, preserving their contributions while developing this fork's game compatibility and renderer fixes. This is an independent fork, not an official release of those upstream projects. Lichii is not affiliated with Nintendo. Visit the [Lichii game compatibility website](https://lichii.zortos.me) to find games and compare community compatibility reports. ## Downloads and setup Download Lichii only from this repository's [releases page](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases). Lichii has no other download site: archives offered elsewhere, such as lichii.org, are not built by this project, and one has been reported to install malware ([#545](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/issues/545)). Linux ARM64 now ships only the standard AppImage and tarball. If no update appears on an older ARM64 PGO build, download the standard ARM64 package from the releases page. On Windows, extract the entire build archive and run **lichii.exe**. Use homebrew you have permission to run, or your own games and system files dumped from a console you own, where permitted by applicable law. Games, keys and firmware are not included. The project does not provide download sources for them. Owning a console or game does not by itself establish permission to bypass access controls or redistribute its files. ### Existing saves and settings Lichii uses its own profile: `%APPDATA%\lichii` on Windows, and the `lichii` directories under `$XDG_DATA_HOME`, `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME` and `$XDG_CACHE_HOME` on Linux and macOS. Without XDG overrides, these are `~/.local/share/lichii`, `~/.config/lichii` and `~/.cache/lichii`. An existing portable `user/` directory still takes priority and is not imported or changed by the wizard. On the first non-portable GUI launch, Lichii offers to import Eden and other detected emulator profiles. Back up `%APPDATA%\eden` first on Windows, or the old data, config and cache directories on Unix, and close the source emulator. Choose **Keep Old Data** to copy without changing the source, then check your saves and relaunch. Existing destination data is retained in backup directories rather than merged. Move also retains a source backup until you remove it yourself; Link deliberately shares settings and saves. Paths outside the imported data root remain shared and unchanged. An interrupted import offers recovery on the next launch. `eden-cli`, including `--help` and `--version`, refuses to initialize configuration until you import or explicitly choose **Start fresh** in the GUI. ## Compatibility and issue reports Compatibility and performance vary by game, hardware and driver. picks.name: VIctory
picks.desc: An attempt at running GTA VI on PC
picks.readme:
# VIctory

Runs Grand Theft Auto VI (Xbox Series X|S) natively on Windows, from files
the user supplies.

The title's x86-64 code runs unchanged inside our process; VIctory supplies
the platform underneath it and converts the title's data, ahead of time where
it can (shaders and pipelines too, see Getting started) and on first use
otherwise. See [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md).

## Status (2026-11-24)

**Not playable yet.** The title boots, runs its menus at its own 30 fps,
loads the world and shows it: slowly, and with rendering defects.

| Stage | State |
|-------|-------|
| Boot, first-boot screens (accessibility, language, settings, legal) | works, 30 fps |
| Intro video with sound | works |
| Start screen, profile and saves | works |
| Loading into the world (about 50 s) | works |
| The world (first mission's intro) | drawn and shown: streets, buildings, vehicles, characters, the title card and credits; 1-2 s per frame. Surfaces are unlit, a band of distant geometry is missing, characters come out broken in some shots |

Tested on one machine: Windows 11, AMD RX 6700 XT.

> **Warning.** Entering the world on a real GPU has hung it in earlier
> builds, and Windows then resets the display driver (every monitor goes
> black for a moment). The latest runs did not, but it is not ruled out; a
> run can also end on a GPU fault (`crashes.log`). A diagnostics build with
> `VICTORY_D3D12_WARP=1` renders on the software adapter instead (too slow
> to reach the world in minutes).

What each part does today and what it still needs:

| Subsystem | Today | Needs |
|-----------|-------|-------|
| Loader | Runs the title's executable and its DLLs in our process; crash reports name the faulting code and are kept in `crashes.log` | – |
| Runtime services | One signed-in offline user, licences, packages, saves that survive a kill at any step, text entry dialog | Speech is silent; the dialog and relaunch are untested live |
| Network | Offline by design: the title cannot reach the network | – |
| Files and streaming | Archives and streamed data read, zlib and BCPack decoded in parallel | Loading is limited by writes into title memory |
| Input | XInput pads, keyboard, keyboard stand-in pad | Trigger rumble |
| Audio | Menu, video and loading sound; XMA voices and Opus streams decode | Reverb is silent; Opus results unverified against the title |
| GPU: menus | Draws, compute and presentation on host D3D12; only changed title memory is copied | Frame pacing drifts on one screen in release builds |
| GPU: world | The scene is drawn and presented: mesh pipelines, indirect execution, views the shaders pick from the heap themselves, title memory read by address (ray-tracing structures), depth written from compute, pipelines pre-built or made by worker threads and kept on disk | Lighting (surfaces are unlit) and some missing geometry; frames take 1-2 s; draws of untranslated shaders are dropped; real queries, depth bounds, HDR and scaling are missing |
| Shaders | Console GPU code recompiled to DXIL, ahead of time (`translate --cache`) or at first use, cached on disk. Menus: all. World: mesh 8,765 of 8,765, vertex/pixel 12,550 of 12,592, compute 2,579 of 2,637 | Merged geometry stages (195 programs) and about 100 others; fused multiply-adds follow the host GPU; some compute programs need a GPU with 64-lane waves |
| Textures | Console tiled layouts and detiling for the modes the title uses | Render-target metadata planes |
| Series S mode | Runs through the menus to the loading screen | The world, as above |

## Getting started

Requirements: Windows 10/11 x64, a CPU with AVX2, a Direct3D 12 GPU with
shader model 6.6 (and mesh shaders for the world), Rust (pinned in
`rust-toolchain.toml`).

To install Rust, use rustup (`winget install --id Rustlang.Rustup -e`, or
the installer from https://rustup.rs). The first `cargo` command in this
repository then fetches the pinned toolchain. Building needs the MSVC C++
